_about: Hand coding of ICJ merits, compensation and interpretation judgments and of advisory opinions with remedial content, read against each decision's operative part. Keys are caseno:date. o = outcome; r = remedies ordered or declared; d = remedies asked for and refused; amt = sums awarded; s = summary in our words. Remedy keys: declaration, satisfaction, cessation, restitution, performance, compensation, non-repetition, negotiate. Outcomes: breach, mixed, no-breach, title, dismissed, compensation, interpretation, declaratory, advisory.

1:1949-04-09.s: Albania responsible for the mine explosions and owes compensation (amount reserved); the British minesweeping of November 1946 violated Albanian sovereignty, and that declaration is itself appropriate satisfaction.
